title: Watercolor Classes with Larry Folding Begin May 1
paragraphs: Guild of Harwich Artists member, Larry Folding will hold Watercolor Classes at the Harwich Cultural Center Tuesdays beginning May 1st thru June 19th from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Classes will be held in the second floor Art Room (elevator available). The cost of the eight week session is $140.

The Harwich Cultural Center, located on Sisson Rd., (the old Harwich Middle School) has easy access from Route 6. Take exit 10 to Harwich Center. Turn right then an immediate left onto Sisson Rd. The center is a short distance on the right.
From Harwich Port or Route 28 take Sisson Rd. (Route 124). The center will be about a half mile on the left just beyond the Fire/Police station.
For registration or further information contact Larry Folding.

Guild of Harwich Artists member, Larry Folding will hold Watercolor Classes at the Harwich Cultural Center Tuesdays beginning May 1st thru June 19th from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Classes will be held in the second floor Art Room (elevator available). The cost of the eight week session is $140.

The Harwich Cultural Center, located on Sisson Rd., (the old Harwich Middle School) has easy access from Route 6. Take exit 10 to Harwich Center. Turn right then an immediate left onto Sisson Rd. The center is a short distance on the right.

From Harwich Port or Route 28 take Sisson Rd. (Route 124). The center will be about a half mile on the left just beyond the Fire/Police station.

For registration or further information contact Larry Folding.
